title: Epic head CI red: classify-tick pin stale after 7sn changed closeout profile
description:
Tick 7sn (05ab6c83b) edited profiles/closeout-epic.md, which changes profileSetDigest and therefore provenance.profile_digest in every classification decision record. cloudflare/test/fixtures/classify-tick-decision.json was not regenerated, so TestTheClassificationRecordIsPinnedAsItIsWritten fails on the epic head (CI run 37380024533, headSha 9e924ef811, job 'go test (reconcile 2/3)'; also 37378487207 and 37376277849). The test is EndToEnd, so the per-tick make gate skipped it. Fix: run `go test ./internal/reconcile -run TestTheClassificationRecordIsPinnedAsItIsWritten -update-pin`, read the one-line diff (profile_digest sha256:3b438330... -> sha256:59098f58...), commit it, and then wait for CI on the epic head to be green. Verified locally: after regeneration the reconcile and runstate pin tests pass.
evidence: internal/reconcile/classify_pin_test.go:106; cloudflare/test/fixtures/classify-tick-decision.json provenance.profile_digest; gh run view 37380024533 --log-failed

ticfac run epic-43y created this tick by absorbing the finding 0a26431e56904296f9887bae487a2ea06daff0a0a4f14f183ae594b9c741bd7e (reported by run-epic-43y/tick-o68/attempt-66): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A5. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/0a26431e56904296f9887bae487a2ea06daff0a0a4f14f183ae594b9c741bd7e.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-10-06 00:14 - ticfac run epic-43y: created by absorbing finding 0a26431e56904296f9887bae487a2ea06daff0a0a4f14f183ae594b9c741bd7e — placed before the close-out, which does not start while it is open; the review had already run. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/0a26431e56904296f9887bae487a2ea06daff0a0a4f14f183ae594b9c741bd7e.json on epic/43y, and it says: the classifier put 0.88 of its probability mass on the items rather than on none, at or above the deliberately cheap absorb threshold of 0.35, and named A5: a false positive costs the epic work it did not need, a false negative closes an epic whose goal is unmet in a factory where nobody is watching, and those are not the same cost — the threshold sits on the cheap side
